description: wire-cases.json#etag-rotation — the rotated state. The SDK presents its previous ETag "v1-fresh"; the stored config now carries "v2-rotated", so the CDN Worker answers 200 with the new ETag and body. A seed is the state that makes its case's server block true (plan 680, US1); the previous initial-state seed relied on a mid-test /admin/seed that no seed consumer performs. Payload = packages/test-fixtures-sdk-parity/fixtures/config-v6.boolean.json, the case's bodyRef (seed-fidelity compares them as JSON).
